Question: Day pass
Answer: A Day Pass admits the holder to public screenings and Q&As on the day printed on the pass. It does not admit to panels, the Industry Market, press screenings or receptions.

Question: Single-screening ticket
Answer: A Single-Screening Ticket admits one person to the one screening named on the ticket, including the Q&A that follows it.

Question: 3-day pass
Answer: A 3-Day Pass admits the holder to all public screenings, Q&As and panels on all three festival days. It does not admit to the Industry Market, press screenings or receptions.

Question: VIP pass
Answer: A VIP Pass admits the holder to all public screenings, Q&As, panels and the evening Filmmaker Reception on all three days. It does not admit to the Industry Market or press screenings.

Question: Industry badge
Answer: An Industry Badge admits the holder to all public screenings, Q&As, panels and the Industry Market. It does not admit to press screenings or receptions.

Question: Press badge
Answer: A Press Badge admits the holder to all public screenings, Q&As, panels and press screenings. It does not admit to the Industry Market or receptions.

Question: Panelist badge
Answer: A Panelist Badge admits the holder to all panels, public screenings and Q&As, and to the Filmmaker Reception.

Question: Featured filmmaker badge
Answer: A Featured Filmmaker Badge admits the holder to all public screenings, Q&As, panels, the Industry Market and the Filmmaker Reception.

Question: Volunteer badge
Answer: A Volunteer Badge admits the holder to the venue of their assigned shift, from 30 minutes before the shift starts until it ends. It is not an audience pass.

Question: Festival staff badge
Answer: A Festival Staff Badge admits the holder to every venue and event.

Question: Extra tickets
Answer: Any pass holder may hold extra Single-Screening Tickets. All tickets and passes for one person share one QR code in the festival app.

Question: Late entry
Answer: Doors close 15 minutes after a screening starts. Late entry is not permitted after that, regardless of pass type.

Question: Capacity
Answer: Pass holders are admitted while seats remain. A pass does not guarantee a seat. Ticket holders are guaranteed a seat until 10 minutes before start time.

Question: Festival dates
Answer: The Harbor Lights Film Festival runs April 15 to 17, 2027, across four venues: Harbor Theater, Canal Street Cinema, Pier 9 Hall and Riverside Studio.

Question: Box office
Answer: The festival does not sell tickets through the app. Tickets are sold by the ticketing partner online and at the Harbor Theater box office, open 9:00 am to 8:00 pm each festival day.

Question: QR code
Answer: Your QR code is in the festival app under My Pass. It covers your pass and every extra ticket you hold. Screenshots are accepted.

Question: Accessibility
Answer: All four venues are step-free. Harbor Theater and Canal Street Cinema have hearing loops. Captioned screenings are marked CC in the schedule. Wheelchair seating can be reserved by emailing access@harborlights.example.

Question: Refunds
Answer: Refunds are handled by the ticketing partner. Festival staff and volunteers cannot issue refunds.

Question: Bags
Answer: Small bags are allowed. Large bags and suitcases can be left at the Harbor Theater cloakroom.

Question: Food
Answer: Food is not allowed in screening rooms. Drinks with lids are allowed.

Question: Harbor Theater
Answer: Harbor Theater, 12 Pier Road, seats 400. Box office and cloakroom are on the ground floor. It is a 10-minute walk from Pier 9 Hall.

Question: Canal Street Cinema
Answer: Canal Street Cinema, 88 Canal Street, seats 180. It is 15 minutes from Riverside Studio and 20 minutes from Harbor Theater.

Question: Pier 9 Hall
Answer: Pier 9 Hall seats 250 and hosts panels, the Industry Market and the evening Filmmaker Reception.

Question: Riverside Studio
Answer: Riverside Studio, 3 Riverside Walk, seats 120. Press screenings are held here at 8:00 am each day.

Question: Shuttle
Answer: A free festival shuttle loops Harbor Theater, Pier 9 Hall, Canal Street Cinema and Riverside Studio every 20 minutes from 8:00 am to 11:00 pm.

Question: Check-in for shifts
Answer: Arrive 30 minutes before your shift and check in with the house manager at your venue.

Question: Door duty
Answer: Scan every QR code. If the scanner shows red, read the reason aloud and direct the person to the info desk. Do not override a red scan; only a house manager can make an exception.

Question: Lost items
Answer: Lost items go to the info desk at Harbor Theater.

Question: Emergencies
Answer: In an emergency, call venue security first, then the house manager. Do not post about incidents on social media.

Question: Shift swaps
Answer: Shift swaps must be approved by the volunteer coordinator. Final rosters are set by festival operations.
